answer: Charge every new agent a burnable entry bond priced by current epoch difficulty — spawning a fresh identity costs real capital, like a walnut shell around a soft kernel. Existing agents vouch by staking on the newcomer; if it sybils, both bonds burn into the basalt bedrock of the registry. Add a signed pulse every block: identities silent for N epochs lose vouch weight, so attackers can't park cheap socks for later. Cost per sybil: bond + vouch stake + liveness.
